name: Cenarion Enclave
summary: The Cenarion Circle gathers in Darnassus beneath Fandral Staghelm’s leadership of the night elven druids. The Cenarion Enclave is their central gathering place and seat of power in the capital, among its great hollows and living boughs.

sections.title: Heart of the Circle
sections.body: High above the Temple Gardens, the Cenarion Enclave gathers the Cenarion Circle beneath ancient oaks and ashes marked with runic bark. Its halls take shape from living wood and stone. With Malfurion Stormrage absent in the Emerald Dream, Archdruid Fandral Staghelm oversees affairs here and presses his ambitious vision for Teldrassil despite political friction with High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. Druids meditate by the streams, while the capital’s elven hunters gather here too. At the stables, skilled riders learn to tame Darnassian nightsabers.

sections.title: Shadows in the Boughs
sections.body: The Cenarion Enclave is known as a tranquil sanctuary, yet quiet business takes place beneath its westernmost bough. A refuge lies under the hollowed roots, where Darnassus’s clandestine rogues work shielded by the canopy above.

faq.answer: Archdruid Fandral Staghelm leads the grove and the night elven druids residing in Darnassus. Malfurion Stormrage, the supreme leader of the Cenarion Circle, remains trapped in a deep, unexplained slumber within the Emerald Dream, leaving Staghelm as the de facto authority.

The Cenarion Enclave is the primary home of Darnassus’s druid trainers, who teach novices among the living trees. Hunter trainers work in the eastern boughs, while rogue trainers have a quiet den in the root warrens beneath the western bough.

faq.q: Where can I buy a nightsaber mount?
faq.answer: Riding trainers and breeders who tend Darnassus’s saber cats wait at the base of the eastern tree near the grove’s entrance. They offer riding training and nightsaber mounts to eligible Alliance travelers.

faq.q: What is the Cenarion Circle's stance toward the Alliance?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle is dedicated to safeguarding the natural order rather than fighting factional wars, though its enclave lies in an Alliance capital. Archdruid Fandral Staghelm leads the enclave and is staunchly nationalist, aligning it strongly with night elven regional interests.

angles.text: As a night elf druid, you find the civil center of your order on Teldrassil here, with training and guidance under Archdruid Fandral Staghelm’s stern direction.
As a hunter, you hone your marksmanship and wilderness lore in the enclave’s eastern boughs, alongside beastmasters who rear Darnassus’s nightsabers.
